description: sst5/answer: dev probs = deployed partial-int8 ONNX (data/v2/sst5/models/final/model.int8.onnx) run with the predict_final.py path (OnnxPredictor, contiguous batches of 32) on the 200 gold dev examples; the model never trained on dev (ub_s1, gold_fold=None), so these are out-of-sample. Reproduces frozen dev_probs.npy exactly and frozen eval_probs.npy exactly (diff 0.0) on 4 eval batches with the same batching. Method chosen by ownyourjev.calibration.select_calibrator (5-fold stratified CV NLL, seed 0) over none/temperature/vector/isotonic, refit on all 200 dev examples. Gold = score rounded to nearest of 5 levels.
